card.name: Digits in prices and doses
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a repeated 9 inside a price such as $9.99 or $39.95. It also fires on a few linking words or mid-word pieces right before a method or amount in instructions.

modes.label: Nines in prices
modes.description: The digit 9 in a dollar amount ending in .99 or .95.

modes.label: Linking word before a method
modes.description: A verb or preposition that introduces how to measure or apply a product, such as using, with or for.
